identities.title: Backend & Platform Engineer
identities.summary: Backend & Platform Engineer with 3 years of experience building highly available and secure distributed systems. Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) with hands-on expertise in Redis HA (Sentinel), RabbitMQ HA, Kubernetes, TLS/mTLS security, and production observability using Prometheus-Grafana.

description: Designed Redis Sentinel HA clusters and Valkey caching layer, implementing TLS encryption for secure inter-service communication and achieving zero-downtime failover capabilities.
Optimized RabbitMQ processing pipeline by implementing batch consumer architecture, improving message throughput by 200% and significantly reducing database load.
Implemented mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication using X.509 certificates across microservices, eliminating plaintext credential exposure.
Built centralized monitoring and alerting infrastructure using Prometheus and Grafana for production observability across Redis, RabbitMQ, and Memcached.
Performed production debugging and performance analysis using Redis Insight to diagnose replication lag and optimize resource utilization.
Implemented persistent Kubernetes storage using Longhorn on bare-metal clusters, ensuring stateful workload durability.
Developed Jenkins pipeline automation and Bash scripts to execute performance tests and generate release validation reports.
Upgraded backend dependencies (Flask, Pydantic, OpenAPI) across microservices, improving service stability and maintainability.
